name: Instant-NGP
aliases: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding
definition: An accelerated version of NeRF that uses Instant neural graphics primitives (NGP) to provide a learnable approach to encode input data, enabling a much smaller neural architecture to be jointly trained without substantial loss of model fidelity.
summary: Instant-NGP accelerates NeRF training and rendering by using multi-resolution hash encoding and occupancy grids to skip empty space, achieving three orders of magnitude speedup while maintaining high visual fidelity.
